xBRIEFInfo.description: Project definition for the fictional Northstar implementation lab

narratives.Overview: A fictional disposable no-remote repository for one bounded test-backed implementation.
narratives.Product: A tiny greeting CLI used only to make readiness, behavior, and diff evidence observable.
narratives.SourceOfTruth: The active xBRIEF owns the one-file product scope; retained evidence lives outside the repository.
narratives.DevelopmentPosture: Private pre-release training fixture with no compatibility layer.
narratives.ProjectRules: Use fictional data only. Keep every mutation inside the unique operating-system temporary repository. After readiness, change only src/greeting.mjs. Do not add a remote, push, open a pull request, merge, deploy, publish, or release.
